- Complete “Ash & Oath,” an original fantasy action-adventure remix inspired by “Fable 2.”
- Validate combat, quest progression, both endings, and runtime behavior.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Set the game in the Gloaming Vale, with combat, a companion dog, a quest, and a moral ending choice.
- Reduce combat difficulty after testing showed the quest was difficult to progress.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, canvas world, keyboard/touch controls, dialogue, combat, progression, and endings.
- Fixed ending UI references, restricted movement and enemy aggression to explore/hunt modes, and added health/will recovery for defeating wisps.
- Added a data favicon to avoid a 404.
- Reduced wisps to 2 HP, increased melee damage to 2, improved defeat recovery, reduced enemy damage, and added a nearest-wisp minimap pointer in hunt mode.
- `node --check game.js` passed; a prior browser check reported 0 console errors.
- Captured and inspected screenshots at 1280px viewport width.

### Active
- Validate that adjusted combat defeats wisps and gathers all five ember-sparks.
- Complete shrine interaction and test both moral endings.
- Check browser console/runtime errors after the full flow.

### Blocked
- Browser combat testing is inconclusive: quest acceptance works, but recent tests still did not confirm wisp defeats or objective progression.

## Next Move
1. Inspect current gameplay position and controls, then test strikes/spells against an accurately targeted wisp.
2. Complete the five-spark quest and test both shrine choices.
3. Check runtime errors, save and inspect the latest ≤1280px JPEG, then summarize results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, combat, quest progression, rendering, and endings.
- `index.html`: Game UI, controls, dialogue, and responsive styling.
- `screenshots/ash-oath-check.jpg`: Earlier inspected gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` are untracked.
- Local server is at `http://localhost:3002`.
